scope: First bounded semantic/proof review of music-first and independent radio activation requirements. Six canonical review groups, not a complete or scored denominator.

groups.trigger: First launch or local defaults/missing legacy options
groups.outcome: Preparation and DJ playback both default off.
variants: Independent saved opt-ins after explicit activation
groups.judgment: Both default functions and normalizers explicitly produce false. Historical native cases cover off-state setup/restart, not a fresh current first-launch/reconnect matrix. Independent activation is reviewed under MF03/MF04.
remaining: Current first-use evidence must show both flags and no unintended dispatch through the whole R1 action.
groups.scopeNote: The table fragments also describe effects and exclusions. Link them to MF03/MF04 as well; default proof alone never accepts the whole fragment.

groups.trigger: Connect Jellyfin, choose libraries and play an album without AI configuration
groups.outcome: Music plays without news-source or text/voice-provider requests; both opt-ins stay off.
variants: Both independent saved flags remain off
groups.judgment: Controlled records establish keyless saved playback and ordinary saves without opt-in. They do not establish one complete current uncoached connect/select/album first-use session. News-source requests here means news collection, not the Jellyfin requests needed to play music.
remaining: Fresh current full R1 engineering journey with dispatch observation
Observed first-attempt listener success under the existing cohort protocol

groups.trigger: Explicitly save an enabled preparation setting with complete prerequisites
groups.outcome: Selected sources are checked and assessed, qualifying script/audio is saved, and DJ playback/music selection are not enabled.
variants: Ordinary setup save with preparation off makes no paid request
Source assessment can produce no qualifying recording
groups.judgment: Current handler validates only enabled saves for provider credentials, retains explicit saved newsEnabled, and never writes djPlayback. Scheduler checks enabled/pause/error/due/budget before serialized reservation. Retained controlled engineering evidence covers dispatch/publication boundaries, not actual sleep/wake or comprehension.
remaining: Observed understanding of authorization/cost before activation
Complete current all-stage evidence linkage including source/provider live limits
groups.scopeNote: RAD17 ordinary setup save means saving while preparation remains off. Saving a deliberately checked preparation switch is the explicit opt-in, not a second hidden authorization step.

groups.trigger: Separately enable DJ breaks and reach a suitable natural ending
groups.outcome: Play eligible complete saved audio without generating new news or changing the selected music queue.
variants: Empty or late pool keeps music playing
No immediate speech merely from enabling
groups.judgment: Current saveDJPlayback writes only DJ settings and requires no provider keys. nextRoomNews reads eligible local audio and reserves it without generating. PR121/122 give current scoped claim/end/continuation evidence. Older keyless record uses a media-time setter, so its exact ending-placement result is not accepted as a current CUA-only reproduction; current natural-ending evidence is separately bounded.
remaining: Fresh combined current keyless + automatic natural-ending run if accepting the entire all-variants group
Observed listener understanding and audible quality
groups.scopeNote: A complete saved file is required before playback, but this does not promise uninterrupted runtime or acceptable subjective sound.

groups.actor: Listener selecting music and host delivery
groups.trigger: Choose a queue or edit the host mood
groups.outcome: Listener keeps control of the music queue; mood supplies host-delivery guidance and does not analyze audio or select songs.
variants: No claim to measured/heard musical mood
groups.judgment: Current prompt calls metadata a style hint and prohibits claiming to hear audio or measure mood. Generation consumes metadata/settings rather than choosing the player queue. Historical native record establishes explanatory wording and controlled queue isolation, not listener comprehension or an exhaustive current negative call-graph proof.
remaining: Complete current queue-mutation/call-boundary audit before exhaustive negative-behavior acceptance
groups.scopeNote: Future music selection is an explicit product exclusion, not an implemented success to inflate a feature score.

groups.outcome: Can review cadence, selection, recording maximum, required providers and potential charges.
variants: Assessment can cost without producing audio
groups.judgment: Current engineering records distinguish visible cost/limit explanations from comprehension. No uncoached listener result exists; this requirement is not accepted.
remaining: Observe the existing listener task before enabling preparation
Link each current visible control/disclosure to its required variant
groups.scopeNote: The isolated numbering fragment RAD-L017-text-01 is structural context for this action, not a separate scored requirement.

policy: Mandatory variants remain together; none of these whole groups is declared accepted.
Direct current source inspection is static evidence, not a new native/live/listener run.
Historical records retain their stated substitutions, driver limitations and tested versions. They are not promoted to current full-flow proof.
One fragment may cover several canonical obligations; every link must be satisfied before accepting the fragment.
Unreviewed application scope, other source lines, STAR actions/contexts and parent gates remain pending.
